description: Looks up the status of a booking or order by its code: the bookingCode or orderCode returned when it was placed (for example WA-K4M2), for a table, stay, service or delivery request, or a pre-order. It needs the restaurantId it was placed at and the phone number it was made with; no sign-in is needed. Returns the status (pending means the venue has not responded yet) and the key details of the booking or order.

phone.description: The phone number the booking or order was made with. Ask the person for it; it is checked together with the code. No sign-in is needed.

name: check_booking_status
title: Check booking or order status
